Recorder
Physical Address:
524 Central Ave
New Rockford, ND 58356
Mailing Address:
524 Central Avenue
New Rockford, North Dakota 58356
Office Hours Monday-Thursday 8am-4pm and Fridays 8am-1pm
701-947-2434 (p) (f)
Services and responsibilities of the Recorder's Office include:
Recording of legal documents in land indexes
Maintaining and preserving records for public use
Issue marriage licenses
Record military discharges - DD-214
Eddy County is a full member of NDRIN (North Dakota Recorders Information Network) and began imaging its real estate records in July of 2003, beginning with Document Number 106744. We are also working on entering and imaging older real estate records. As of July 23, 2025 we have documents entered back to March 1981. You can view these documents at ND Recorders Information Network | Home Page (ndrin.com) .
Tiffany Harr, Recorder
tharr@nd.gov
701-947-2434 ext 3 or 4
